title: After One Hour With You
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

successful_carousel_standard.rule: Build a public identity mirror with concrete couple receipts, active Zuv care, an emotional reversal, and a send/save thesis; stage the story in visible actions before choosing poster text; do not optimize for keywords.
successful_carousel_standard.open_reasoning_policy: Expose the real goal and selection logic; do not optimize for keywords or let slide copy substitute for staged story action.
successful_carousel_standard.prompt_rule: Prompts must prove relationship behavior through stage-scene Aachu/Zuv action; text completes the scene instead of carrying it.

human_truth: Some people do not solve the problem; their presence changes the emotional texture of the same life until it feels softer and more bearable.
emotional_arc: crowded inner weather -> quiet presence -> unchanged problem -> softened body -> bearable life
source_story_summary: A soft couple carousel inspired by the idea: some people are human medicine. You spend an hour with them and everything feels better. The approved direction is not stress reset or fixing problems; it is different emotion after being with them. Same thoughts, same worries, same life, but their presence changes the emotional weather and makes everything feel softer and more bearable.
visual_style: Create a premium hand-drawn romantic watercolor-and-ink @a.storyof.two Instagram post illustration in native 3:4 portrait composition when the requested surface is Instagram post: generate the source at 1440x1920 and export proportionally to exact 1080x1440 final. Generate separate native 9:16 artwork for Reels/Stories when needed. Always use config/references/a-story-illustration-master-prompt.md, config/references/a-story-premium-illustration-style-lock.md, and the style bundle in config/references/style-lock/observational-intimacy-premium/. Use shared images only as mood/composition references unless the creator explicitly says otherwise or the images clearly depict the requested people/couple for this prompt; in that case, treat them as current-request identity references for faces, expressions, posture, wardrobe anchors, and relationship energy. Preserve their emotional essence, copy, message, story, gesture, objects, and requested composition, but never let an external reference style take over. Use the Aachu/Zuv identity reference as the face and wardrobe anchor always. Identity reference images are the highest-priority face source: preserve the same recurring real-person Aachu/Zuv faces, expressions, warm medium-brown South Asian skin tones, Aachu's expressive dark eyes and long dark wavy hair, and Zuv's curly dark hair, strong brows, dark almond eyes, defined nose, short natural stubble, and gentle smile. Previous successful illustrations are style references only: use them for warm ivory paper, visible paper grain, fine ink and pencil linework, transparent watercolor blooms, delicate sketch texture, muted vintage palette, tactile clothing detail, soft faded edges, lower/middle-lower couple placement, and generous clean upper-middle negative space. Render exact handwritten text in upper-middle negative space, matching the approved handwritten font styles from the reference images. Every final illustration must include only the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' in the top-right as part of the paper artwork. No photorealism, no UI, no random text, no quote-card design. Scene logic and pose anatomy are hard gates: clothing, props, and body action must prove the exact copy, and any visible people must look natural, flattering, and physically believable.
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

stage_scene_gate.action: An emotionally crowded partner enters the room with a phone/bag/day still attached, then the other partner quietly comes close and sits beside them.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Shoulders drop, hands unclench, the phone turns face down, and the room opens without the practical problem disappearing.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Attention shifts from phone/world to the person beside them; the partner watches gently without a fixing or advice pose.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Bag drops, phone stays visible, hands move from clenched/active to relaxed/near-touch, and ordinary objects remain in frame as proof that life is unchanged.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The strongest beat is quiet side-by-side presence, not a speech or solution.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The viewer can understand the relationship truth even with text hidden: the same room feels softer because of who is there.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: Maybe love is one person making life feel bearable again.

authorial_flow.proof_engine: S1: A warm interior scene with one partner arriving emotionally crowded by the day: bag dropped, phone in hand, shoulders tense, the room feeling slightly compressed. The other partner is present nearby but not heroic or therapist-like, simply noticing with gentle attention. The feeling should be weather-like through light and posture, not literal clouds. -> S2: A closer, slightly crowded frame: notifications glow on the phone, keys or bag are messy, shoulders lifted, eyes tired. The other partner is not solving anything yet; the room and objects make the loudness visible without using literal sound effects. -> S3: A wider room scene where the practical world is still visible: phone, small bills or notebook without readable text, laundry or daily objects, unfinished cup. One partner is mid-thought, the other sits close enough to be present. Nothing is fixed yet. -> S4: The partner simply sits beside them on the bed, sofa, or floor edge. No advice pose, no lecture. Hands are close but not forced; eye-line softens; body distance reduces a little. The scene should prove presence as the action. -> S5: A gentle mid-hour beat: the tense partner is now exhaling, maybe leaning back or laughing softly while still holding the phone face down. The other partner's presence makes the body loosen; hands unclench, shoulders drop. Use chest/shoulder posture as the receipt. -> S6: The key proof slide: same phone/problem remains in the frame, but the emotional weather has changed. The couple is calmer, closer, maybe sharing a small laugh or quiet side-by-side silence. The outside world is unchanged; light and posture are softer. -> S7: A final quiet wide shot after the hour: both people settled close in the same room, ordinary objects still around, but the frame breathes. One small shared gesture, like shoulder against shoulder, fingers touching, or a shared smile, lands the emotional thesis without grand romance.

carousel_story_director_persona.source_story: A soft couple carousel inspired by the idea: some people are human medicine. You spend an hour with them and everything feels better. The approved direction is not stress reset or fixing problems; it is different emotion after being with them. Same thoughts, same worries, same life, but their presence changes the emotional weather and makes everything feel softer and more bearable.
